subject: Demo: Quick technical walkthrough — timezone & engineer availability

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Demo: Quick technical walkthrough

Hi Taylor —

Thanks for signing up for the self-serve trial. I'm Soojin from Redwood's SDR team — quick auto-follow to get you into the right meeting slot with our AE/engineer pair.

Two quick asks so we can tailor the session:
- Confirm your time zone (I see PST by default).
- Which one goal is highest priority for the call? e.g., latency/cost optimization, private deployment, or model compatibility.

Pick any 30-minute slot here: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/s/soojin-30m
(If none of those work reply with a few windows and I'll propose alternatives.)

I've attached a short one-pager about what we'll cover if your team wants to pre-read.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (pdf)]

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Quick technical walkthrough

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Confirming: we operate on CST (UTC-6). Our main goal is to understand how Redwood would slot into our existing inference pipeline (latency and cost are both important).

Available windows tomorrow (CST):
- 10:00–10:30
- 14:00–14:30
- 16:00–16:30

If you can get an engineer on the call that would be ideal. I've dropped a short note in HubSpot under the account.

Thanks,
Taylor Nguyen
Platform Lead — Acme Corp
taylor@acme.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: ""
Date: 2027-06-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Quick technical walkthrough

Hi Taylor —

Thanks for the details and for listing windows. Karthik here (AE) — I can take the call and will bring one of our inference engineers, Priya, to answer architecture/quantization questions.

I converted the times into PST and proposed two concrete slots on the calendar so it is easy to choose:
- Wed Jun 30 — 12:00–12:30 PDT (10:00–10:30 CST)
- Wed Jun 30 — 16:00–16:30 PDT (14:00–14:30 CST)

Please pick the one that works best via the short booking link: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/s/karthik-30m (or reply directly and we'll drop an invite).

Attached: small ICS with the first proposed slot and the demo brief Soojin referenced.

Looking forward — we'll focus on how to preserve tail latency under high throughput and what quantized model pathways we recommend for cost savings.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Karthik — 12:00–12:30 PDT (10:00–10:30 CST) works for us. I've accepted the invite. Looking forward to a short agenda that covers:
1) current infra fit (GPU vs CPU tradeoffs)
2) expected latency numbers for our workload size
3) cost estimates and quantization options

If you need any logs or perf numbers ahead of time I can drop them into the HubSpot record (link below).

See you then —
Taylor
